atomic_facts.fact: Northvolt AB filed for bankruptcy in Sweden.
The Swedish bankruptcy filing occurred on March 12, 2025.
Northvolt filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the United States.
The Chapter 11 filing occurred on November 21, 2024.
Creditors have filed claims against Northvolt AB in its bankruptcy proceedings.
Subcontractors that worked on the Skellefteå site are owed millions in unpaid invoices by Northvolt entities (i.e., they are creditors).
Major financial institutions (e.g., Swedish Export Credit Corporation, EIB, ING, BNP Paribas, Santander) are creditors of Northvolt AB.
Northvolt AB's Swedish corporate registration number (orgnr) is 559015-8894.
Northvolt AB's registered/legal address is Alströmergatan 20, 112 47 Stockholm, Sweden.
